uniform_results.rank_rule: sum_j min(r, distinct (a,b) in class j)
uniform_results.all_parameter_generic_count: O(n^2*log(n+1)^2), with an absolute constant for all r,m and all base-field characteristics
uniform_results.count_proof: Nested core thresholds; t>=2*alpha gives an axis box of volume <=2048*n, covered by O(log(n+1)^2) fixed-volume dyadic boxes. Otherwise k<=1 gives an integer profile box of volume O(n^3*m^2), hence O(n^4) for m<=r. Use period stabilization when m>r.
uniform_results.exact_selection_cost: O(n*log(r+1)) exact comparisons and arithmetic operations, O(r) queue/seen working storage, plus O(n) output; not a bit-complexity or random-access claim
uniform_results.unconditional_axis_box_bound: False: m=s^3,r=s^4 has strict bases with axis-box volume/length>s, for every integer s>=3.
uniform_results.remaining_polynomial_amplification_windo: None in the generic cyclic family: the uniform quadratic-logarithmic bound closes the former intermediate window. Arbitrary planar B remains outside the sharper theorem.

scope: Uniform proofs plus bounded exact controls. The new dichotomy is checked through a direct accessible-lattice heap against all saved complete fans and independent finite-ground sorting. Thin-threshold bases are independently enumerated by degree tiers. The all-parameter bound requires generic planar columns; no empirical growth, unrestricted moment bound or unrestricted G3 improvement is inferred.
